description: Icon chip + pill label: a rounded icon tile pops in with a spring and a turn, the pill grows out of it and the text types on; an optional second chip follows. Calls to action, steps, features, UI-style callouts over footage. Transparent.

params.icon: A symbol or emoji for the tile, e.g. → ✓ ★ ↓ (default →)
params.position: center | top-left | top | top-right | left | right | bottom-left | bottom | bottom-right (default bottom-left)
params.background: Solid background used only for opaque .mp4 output
